units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 9a:9">B. Bath. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>אין בודקין לכ׳</he> we must not investigate in the case of a poor man asking for clothes; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:8">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00989"><he>דִּקְדֵּק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:1">Tam. I, 1</cite> <he>ומתכסין בכ׳ עצמן</he> and covered themselves with their own (private) garments; a. fr.—[Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78ᶜ <he>ואפי׳ כ׳</he>, read <cite ref="K01003"><he>כָּפוּת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="J00048"><he>יָבַל</he></cite>.]
